summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Harbor Mid Cap Core ETF (EPMB) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in mid cap equity. The fund is actively managed, investing in 50-70 mid-cap companies in the US, selected using fundamental research. The fund seeks total return. EPMB was launched on May 1, 2025 and is issued by Harbor.

holdings.infoBox: EPMB is an equity ETF with a total of 60 individual holdings. The top holdings are Us Dollar stock at 4.06%, Twilio at 3.62%, Keysight Technologies at 3.56%, Entegris at 3.10%, and Woodward at 2.82%.
